claim.summary: Over any field, for P=sum_a lambda_a product_(j=1)^(q_a)(c_aj+ell_aj) in a free algebra, ell homogeneous linear, every degree-r component and nontrivial contiguous position cut 1<=p<r has coefficient matrix rank at most sum_a q_a. Group by the factor supplying the p-th selected letter; constants skipped, prefix degree p-1 and suffix degree r-p. Empty-sided cuts rank<=1, absent components zero. Therefore for each fixed graph maximum degree Delta the explicit binary complete ternary one-hot Tseitin certificate of binary-word-rank-witness, s=n+m+1, has contiguous component ranks O_Delta(s^3) after every binary affine substitution of its free letters; all original generator labels remain in underlying certificate, transformed object only analysis, no uniform growing-Delta or small fixed-depth binary witness asserted. Binary coefficient matrix rank agrees with F4 rank. In contrast H=degree-2r component of product_(j=1)^(3r)(1+X_j), r>=1, has odd/even position rank>=2^r over every field. Restrict odd letter i to X_(3i-2) or X_(3i-1), even to X_(3i-1) or X_(3i): submatrix is tensor power of [[1,1],[0,1]]. Original binary product has O(r) gate/wire formula size and depth2, so no generic polynomial interleaved component-rank upper bound holds for arbitrary shallow inhomogeneous binary formulas. Written affine substitution of max formula size a into size-S depth-d formula costs O(Sa), depth<=d+1; no free component extraction inferred. Fixed-degree and zero/constant controls retained. Does not refute a property restricted to matched small binary certificates, all-depth certificate hardness or Frege lower bound.
